descriptor: Revenue growth platform for sales teams

voice.summary: APEX talks like a sales operator who respects time: short, active and focused on pipeline. It names workflows and lead stages directly.
dos: Name workflows, funnels and leads plainly
Use active verbs: drive, track, close
donts: Do not use buzzwords like synergy
